gyeonu.definitionKo: 견우와 직녀 이야기에 나오는 남자 목동. 은하수를 사이에 두고 직녀와 헤어져 있다가 일 년에 단 한 번, 음력 7월 7일에 까치와 까마귀가 놓아 준 다리인 오작교에서 직녀와 만날 수 있다고 한다.
gyeonu.englishDescription: The herdsman in the story of Gyeonuwajingnyeo,The Herdsman and the Weaver;  said to be separated from his lover, a weaver, by the Milky Way, the lovers meet only once a year on the 7th day of the 7th month by the lunar calendar, when crows and magpies come together to make the Okjakgyo, the Crow-Magpie Bridge, for them.

jjigae.definitionKo: 국물을 적게 하여 고기나 두부, 채소 등을 넣고 고추장이나 된장 등을 넣고 양념과 간을 맞추어 약간 짜게 끓인 반찬.
jjigae.englishDescription: A side dish made by putting tofu, vegetables, etc., in a small amount of broth with doenjang, soybean paste, or gochujang, red chili paste, and then boiling it with some spices or seasonings to taste a little salty.

mundane.definitionKo: 높은 이상이나 종교적 믿음이 없이 세상의 일반적인 풍속을 따르는.
mundane.englishDescription: Following the general customs of the world without any high ideal or religious belief.

mutualism.definitionKo: 다른 종류의 생물이 서로 도우며 함께 살아감.
mutualism.englishDescription: The state of living beings living together and in so doing acting in ways that help each other.

reside.englishDescription: To stay and live in a certain place.
For a person to stay and live in a certain place.

reside.definitionKo: 일정 기간 동안 자리를 잡고 머물러 살다.
reside.englishDescription: To settle and live in a place for a certain amount of time.
To stay at one place continuously.

submergence.englishDescription: The state of being immersed underwater.
The act of going into water so that one's body is completely covered with water.
The act of submerging or moving under the ground.

sumptuously.englishDescription: Having a luxurious and extravagant attitude.

ugly.englishDescription: Ugly and not pretty in appearance.

ugly.definitionKo: 얼굴 생김새나 표정 등이 흉하거나 험상궂다.
ugly.englishDescription: One's looks, facial expression, etc., being ugly or tough.

ugly.definitionKo: 하는 짓이나 모습이 마음에 들지 않고 눈꼴사납다.
ugly.englishDescription: One's behavior or appearance being displeasing and disgusting.

ugly.definitionKo: 하는 짓이나 모습이 보기에 아주 좋지 않다.
ugly.englishDescription: One's behavior or conduct being not pleasant to see.
Ugly and not pretty in appearance.

ugly.definitionKo: 사람이나 사물의 모습이 보기에 좋지 않다.
ugly.englishDescription: A person or object not having a good appearance.
One's looks, etc., being unattractive and appearing unsightly.
(figurative) The face of a woman who is not pretty.
The atmosphere or circumstances being very bad.
A certain situation or atmosphere being wild and dangerous.

ugly.definitionKo: 생김새나 태도가 마음에 들지 않거나 징그럽다.
ugly.englishDescription: Appearance or attitude being unsatisfactory or displeasing.

vinegar.definitionKo: 원료를 발효시켜서 만드는 신맛이 나는 액체 조미료.
vinegar.englishDescription: A liquid seasoning that tastes sour made by fermenting raw ingredients.

vinegar.definitionKo: 원료를 발효시켜서 만드는 신맛이 나는 액체 조미료.
vinegar.englishDescription: A sour liquid condiment that is made from wine or malt.

wow.definitionKo: 기쁨이나 감동의 느낌을 나타낼 때 내는 소리.
wow.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker expresses his/her delight or excitement.

wow.definitionKo: 뜻밖에 기쁜 일이 생겼을 때 내는 소리.
wow.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when something pleasant happens unexpectedly.

wow.definitionKo: 안타까움이나 아쉬움, 놀라움의 뜻을 나타낼 때 하는 말.
wow.englishDescription: An exclamation used to express the feelings of contrition, regret, or surprise.

wow.definitionKo: 안타까움이나 아쉬움, 놀라움의 뜻을 나타낼 때 하는 말.
wow.englishDescription: An exclamation to express the feelings of contrition, regret, or surprise.
An exclamation uttered when the speaker is surprised or glad.

wow.definitionKo: 뜻밖에 좋은 일로 기쁘거나 놀랐을 때 내는 소리.
wow.englishDescription: A sound made when one is happy or surprised by something unexpected and good.

wow.definitionKo: 예상과 달라서 놀라거나 감탄할 때 내는 소리.
wow.englishDescription: A sound made when you are surprised or amazed by something that is different from what you expected.

wow.definitionKo: 매우 반갑거나 좋을 때 내는 소리.
wow.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker feels very glad or good.

wow.definitionKo: 매우 반갑거나 좋을 때 다급하게 지를 때 내는 소리.
wow.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered quickly when the speaker feels very glad or good.

wow.definitionKo: 크게 감동하거나 매우 속상하여 한숨을 쉴 때 내는 소리.
wow.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker is greatly impressed or sighs because he/she is upset.

wow.definitionKo: 반갑거나 기분이 좋아서 어쩔 줄을 모를 때 내는 소리.
wow.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker does not know what to do because he/she is glad or happy.

wow.definitionKo: 반갑거나 기분이 좋아서 어쩔 줄을 모를 때 내는 소리.
wow.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker is beside himself/herself with joy.

wow.definitionKo: 새롭다고 느끼거나 감탄했을 때 내는 소리.
wow.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker is surprised or impressed by a newly realized fact.

wow.definitionKo: 놀라움, 기쁨, 화남 등의 느낌을 나타내거나 갑자기 힘을 쓸 때 내는 소리.
wow.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker expresses surprise, joy, anger, etc., or puts forth his/her strength suddenly.

wow.definitionKo: 좀 놀라거나 감탄할 때 내는 소리.
wow.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker is a little surprised or impressed.
An exclamation uttered when the speaker is impressed.

wow.definitionKo: 뜻밖에 기쁜 일이 생겼을 때 내는 소리.
wow.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when something pleasant happens unexpectedly.
An exclamation that several people shout together vigorously.

wow.definitionKo: 안타까움이나 아쉬움, 놀라움의 뜻을 나타낼 때 하는 말.
wow.englishDescription: An exclamation used to express the feelings of contrition, regret or surprise.
